info.title: Hulaki.Cli
info.description: The hulaki command: prints every provider's capability manifest, sends a test message through a channel URL, and checks a channel URL without sending. Secrets in channel URLs are never printed.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Hulaki: deliver a message to chat, push and social platforms.

commands.name: capabilities
commands.description: Print what every provider supports, from its capability manifest.

options.name: --markdown
options.description: Print the Markdown of docs/capabilities.md. [default: False]

commands.name: send
commands.description: Send one message through a channel URL and print the outcome.

options.name: --channel-url
options.description: The channel as a URL, for example telegram://<bot-token>@telegram. It holds a secret: prefer an environment variable to typing it, so it stays out of shell history.

options.name: --to
options.description: The recipient address. Omit it for channels that post to their own feed or webhook.

options.name: --property
options.description: A recipient property as key=value, repeatable. Web Push needs p256dh and auth.

commands.name: doctor
commands.description: Check a channel URL and build the channel without sending anything.

options.name: --channel-url
options.description: The channel as a URL, for example telegram://<bot-token>@telegram. It holds a secret: prefer an environment variable to typing it, so it stays out of shell history.
